name: Arachnophobia
definition: An extreme or irrational fear of spiders and other arachnids.
description: Arachnophobia is one of the most common specific phobias. Individuals often experience intense anxiety or panic when encountering spiders or even viewing images of them.
symptoms: Rapid heart rate, sweating, trembling, panic attacks, urge to escape, freeze response.

name: Acrophobia
definition: An extreme or irrational fear of heights.
description: Acrophobia involves intense anxiety triggered by elevated places like tall buildings, bridges, cliffs, or balconies.
symptoms: Dizziness, loss of balance, nausea, intense fear of falling, feeling compelled to drop to the ground.

name: Claustrophobia
definition: An extreme or irrational fear of confined or enclosed spaces.
summary: Fear of enclosed or tight spaces.
description: Claustrophobia is triggered by being in tight, restricted, or crowded spaces such as elevators, small rooms, or windowless spaces.
symptoms: Shortness of breath, chest tightness, sweating, feeling trapped, urgent need to leave.

name: Thalassophobia
definition: An intense and persistent fear of deep, vast, or open bodies of water.
summary: Fear of the ocean or deep water.
description: Thalassophobia centers on the mystery, vastness, dark depths, and unknown creatures hidden within oceans or deep lakes.
symptoms: Hyperventilation, rapid pulse, dread when looking at ocean imagery, sense of impending doom.

name: Ophidiophobia
definition: An extreme fear of snakes.
description: Sufferers experience overwhelming anxiety triggered by live snakes, photos, videos, or snake-like objects.
symptoms: Extreme terror, crying, panic, physical paralysis, elevated heart rate.

name: Aerophobia
definition: An extreme fear of flying or being in aircraft.
description: Aerophobia involves intense distress associated with traveling in airplanes, helicopters, or other air vehicles.
symptoms: Nausea, panic attacks during takeoff or turbulence, sweating, gastrointestinal distress.

name: Nyctophobia
definition: An extreme, irrational fear of the dark or night.
description: Nyctophobia is characterized by an intense fear of darkness, driven by the perception of unseen threats lurking in the dark.
symptoms: Insomnia, severe anxiety at night, compulsion to leave lights on, elevated heart rate.

name: Cynophobia
definition: An overwhelming or irrational fear of dogs.
description: Cynophobia is an animal phobia involving severe anxiety triggered by dogs of any size or breed.
symptoms: Freezing in place, screaming, running away, hyperventilating, heart palpitations.

name: Glossophobia
definition: An intense fear of public speaking or speaking in front of an audience.
description: Glossophobia is a widespread anxiety response where individuals feel intense dread when required to perform or present in front of a group.
symptoms: Dry mouth, shaky voice, excessive sweating, trembling hands, stomach butterflies.

name: Trypophobia
definition: An aversion or revulsion to repetitive patterns of small holes, bumps, or clusters.
summary: Fear or revulsion of clustered hole patterns.
description: Trypophobia is triggered by seeing closely packed groups of tiny holes or bumps, such as honeycombs or seed pods.
symptoms: Skin crawling, goosebumps, intense disgust, nausea, itchiness, visual discomfort.

name: Astraphobia
definition: An extreme fear of thunder and lightning.
description: Astraphobia causes severe anticipatory anxiety during incoming weather, leading sufferers to seek windowless shelters.
symptoms: Trembling, seeking shelter under covers, obsessively monitoring weather forecasts, crying.

name: Hemophobia
definition: An intense and irrational fear of blood.
description: Hemophobia stands out because it frequently causes a vasovagal response—a sudden drop in blood pressure that leads to fainting.
symptoms: Fainting, lightheadedness, nausea, rapid pulse followed by sudden drop in heart rate.

name: Trypanophobia
definition: An extreme fear of medical procedures involving needles or injections.
description: Trypanophobia involves severe distress when facing blood draws, vaccinations, or IV lines.
symptoms: Dizziness, fainting, extreme dread prior to appointments, flight response.

name: Agoraphobia
definition: An anxiety disorder involving fear of environments that might cause panic, helplessness, or embarrassment.
summary: Fear of open, crowded, or unavoidable spaces.
description: Agoraphobia involves avoiding places where escape might be difficult or help unavailable during a panic attack.
symptoms: Refusal to leave home, dependence on a companion, panic attacks, chest pain.

name: Pyrophobia
definition: An extreme or irrational fear of fire.
description: Pyrophobia causes overwhelming distress in the presence of open flames, campfires, candles, or smoke.
symptoms: Obsessive checking of heat sources, extreme panic near flames, nausea, rapid breathing.

name: Mysophobia
definition: An extreme or irrational fear of germs, contamination, and dirt.
description: Mysophobia drives individuals to engage in compulsive cleaning, handwashing, and excessive avoidance of unsterilized surfaces.
symptoms: Compulsive handwashing, overuse of disinfectants, avoidance of physical contact, panic near dirt.

name: Coulrophobia
definition: An abnormal or exaggerated fear of clowns.
description: Coulrophobia is often triggered by the exaggerated features, makeup, and unpredictable behavior associated with clown performers.
symptoms: Tears, extreme anxiety, elevated heart rate, nausea, overwhelming distress.

name: Entomophobia
definition: An extreme or persistent fear of insects.
description: Entomophobia involves intense fear of bugs, beetles, bees, or crawling insects, leading people to avoid outdoor activities.
symptoms: Screaming, sensation of bugs crawling on skin, panic, immediate urge to escape outdoors.

name: Emetophobia
definition: An intense, irrational fear of vomiting or seeing others vomit.
description: Emetophobia can severely impact eating habits, social gatherings, travel, and health behaviors due to a fear of nausea or sickness.
symptoms: Severe food restriction, hyper-awareness of stomach sensations, panic when feeling sick.

name: Gerascophobia
definition: An abnormal or excessive fear of growing old or aging.
description: Gerascophobia centers on anxiety surrounding physical decline, loss of independence, changing appearance, and mortality.
symptoms: Obsessive preoccupation with youthful appearance, anxiety about birthdays, severe dread of physical decline.
